sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at home this weekend in what shapes up as an intriguing battle between two of the division's in-form sides. Sandbach come into the fixture unbeaten in their last five games (four wins and a draw), sitting third with 19 points, while Eccleshall are fourth on 18 points and have won four of their last five matches. Both teams are firmly in contention in the upper reaches of the table, making this a significant clash.
divisionWide: The title race remains wide open at the top, with AFC Bridgnorth (19 points) and Stafford Town (19 points) both in imperious form—Bridgnorth unbeaten in their last six games and Stafford winning their most recent outing. Bridgnorth travel to Brereton Social while Stafford host Cheadle Heath Nomads, offering both teams chances to maintain their momentum. Elsewhere, Market Drayton Town face Bilston Town in a fixture between sides chasing different objectives; Bilston are climbing the table with recent wins, while Market Drayton have mixed form. New Mills entertain Dawley Town in a meeting of mid-table sides both capable of inconsistency. Foley Meir play Widnes Town in a clash between struggling sides—Widnes remain winless with just two points from seven games, while Foley Meir have shown some resilience with recent victories. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Shawbury United, where the visitors' recent form (five points from eight games) gives them a slight edge over hosts struggling with losses in their last three outings. Allscott Heath host Alsager Town in a basement battle—both teams are in the relegation zone with Alsager having won just once all season. Crewe host Wednesfield Community in another lower-table encounter, while Telford Town face Barnton with both teams fighting for points after difficult recent spells.
